claims.claim_text: On May 28, 2025, APLD subsidiaries APLD ELN-02 LLC and APLD ELN-03 LLC entered into two data center leases with CoreWeave, Inc. delivering an aggregate of 250 MW (100 MW + 150 MW) of HPC infrastructure at Polaris Forge 1, Ellendale, ND. On July 24, 2025, CoreWeave exercised a lease option for an additional 150 MW in a third building.
claims.subject: Applied Digital Corp
claims.object_value: CoreWeave 15-year leases totaling 400 MW (250 MW signed + 150 MW option) at Polaris Forge 1, Ellendale ND
claims.source_quote: On May 28, 2025, APLD ELN-02 LLC and APLD ELN-03 LLC, our subsidiaries, each entered into a data center lease (together, the Data Center Leases) with CoreWeave, Inc. to deliver an aggregate of 250 MW of infrastructure to host CoreWeave's HPC operations at Polaris Forge 1.... On July 24, 2025, CoreWeave exercised its lease option for an additional 150 MW in a third building at Polaris Forge 1.

claims.claim_text: APLD's Data Center Hosting Business operates 286 MW total (106 MW Jamestown ND + 180 MW Ellendale ND) at full capacity as of May 31, 2025, serving one crypto-mining customer with a 2.5-year remaining contract term, and accounted for 100% of continuing-operations revenue ($144.2 million segment revenue) in FY2025.
claims.subject: Applied Digital Corp
claims.object_value: 286 MW crypto-hosting capacity (Jamestown 106 MW + Ellendale 180 MW); single crypto-mining anchor customer; $144.2M segment revenue FY25
claims.source_quote: As of May 31, 2025, our 106 MW facility in Jamestown, North Dakota and our 180 MW facility in Ellendale, North Dakota continue to operate at full capacity.... We currently serve one crypto mining customer with a remaining contractual term of two and a half years.

claims.claim_text: On January 13, 2025, APLD's subsidiary APLDH entered into a Unit Purchase Agreement with Macquarie Asset Management (MIP VI HPC Holdings, LLC) to sell an interest in the HPC Hosting Business. Closing is conditioned on APLDH executing a lease with a hyperscaler for the first 100 MW of Polaris Forge 1; the termination date was extended to October 13, 2025.

claims.predicate: agreed to sell HPC Hosting interest to
claims.object_value: Macquarie Asset Management (MAM) UPA, closing conditional on hyperscaler lease execution at Polaris Forge 1
claims.source_quote: on January 13, 2025, APLD HPC Holdings LLC (APLDH)... entered into a Unit Purchase Agreement... with MIP VI HPC Holdings, LLC, which is an affiliate of funds and investment vehicles managed by entities within Macquarie Asset Management (MAM). The closing under the UPA is subject to certain closing conditions, including, APLDH executing a lease with a hyperscaler for the first 100 MW of Polaris Forge 1, in a form acceptable to MAM

claims.object_value: single counterparty CoreWeave, 15-year terms, two leases (250 MW)
claims.source_quote: We currently have one customer in this business segment, which is a party to two fifteen-year term leases with us.

claims.claim_text: APLD disclosed a material weakness in internal control over financial reporting as of May 31, 2025, related to accounting for complex financial instruments; disclosure controls and procedures were not effective as of fiscal year-end.
claims.subject: Applied Digital Corp
claims.object_value: material weakness ICFR (complex financial instruments); DCP not effective as of 5/31/2025
claims.source_quote: concluded that our disclosure controls and procedures were not effective as of May 31, 2025, as a result of the material weakness in our internal control over financial reporting... We have identified a material weakness in the design of our internal controls as we did not design and maintain effective controls around the accounting and assessment of complex financial instruments.

claims.claim_text: APLD has a heavily-dilutive and distress-flavored capital structure: $450M of 2.75% senior unsecured Convertible Notes (Nov 2024), $375M SMBC Loan (maturity August 2026), Macquarie Promissory Note (since repaid), $160M PIPE at $3.24, Series E/E-1/F/G preferred stock issuances, $193.9M ATM (June 2025), and an $89.6M loss on conversion-option derivative due to insufficient authorized shares during a two-week period. Net loss FY25 = $231.1M.
claims.subject: Applied Digital Corp
claims.object_value: $450M Convertibles, $375M SMBC loan, multiple preferred series, $160M PIPE, $89.6M derivative loss; $231M net loss FY25
claims.source_quote: The aggregate principal amount of the Convertible Notes sold in the offering was $450 million... $85.4 million loss on change in fair value of debt primarily due a loss of approximately $89.6 million related to the change in fair value of the conversion option derivative of the Convertible Note during the two week period in which the Company did not have sufficient authorized shares to settle such conversion fully in shares.

claims.claim_text: On March 30, 2026, APLD and CoreWeave amended the Building 2 lease (suspending term for two of four data halls) and CoreWeave assigned Building 3 lease in full to a wholly-owned SPV (CoreWeave Compute Acquisition Co. VIII, LLC), with CoreWeave only providing 'springing' (conditional) guaranties and a $50M letter of credit. This represents a credit-quality deterioration of the original parent-guaranteed CoreWeave lease commitment disclosed in the FY25 10-K.
claims.subject: Applied Digital Corp
claims.object_value: CoreWeave SPV substitution, springing guaranty, partial-term suspension on 2 of 4 data halls in Building 2
claims.source_quote: On March 30, 2026, the Company and CoreWeave amended the lease for Building 2 (the ELN-02 Parent Lease) to suspend the term for two of the four data halls covered by the lease... and the Company entered into a new data center lease with CoreWeave Compute Acquisition Co. VIII, LLC (CoreWeave SPV), a wholly owned subsidiary of CoreWeave, for those same two data halls... CoreWeave delivered to APLD ELN-02 LLC an Unconditional Springing Guaranty of Payment and Performance... CoreWeave is obligated to provide a letter of credit in the amount of $50,000,000 to secure obligations under the ELN-02 Parent Lease within 30 days of March 30, 2026.

claims.claim_text: APLD's HPC Hosting Business commenced operations at its first Polaris Forge 1 building during the nine months ended February 28, 2026, recognizing approximately $182.3M of HPC revenue, of which $118.2M (65%) was tenant fit-out services, $55.7M base rent and $8.4M power pass-through. Q3 (three months ended 2/28/2026) HPC revenue was $71.0M with $44.1M base rent and $18.9M fit-out.

claims.object_value: $182.3M YTD HPC revenue (65% fit-out / 30% rent / 5% pass-through); Q3 $71M HPC (62% rent)
